Container.Name: hyperbay
Container.Overview:
A decentralized bay for open-source model weights. The catalog is a multi-writer Autobase, the weights are one Hyperdrive per model, and discovery runs over the Hyperswarm DHT — so this container is a full peer, not a client of a server.
Run it as a seedbox: it mirrors what you publish or fetch and serves those bytes to anyone else on the bay. The built-in HTTP bridge lets ordinary tools read from the swarm, with Range support so broken transfers resume:
curl -O http://TOWER_IP:8433/f/<owner>/<name>/<file> HF_ENDPOINT=http://TOWER_IP:8433 huggingface-cli download <owner>/<name>
The web UI is on the same port. It has no authentication and it can publish, seed and delete on this node's behalf, so keep it on a trusted network or put it behind a reverse proxy with auth.
The appdata volume holds the corestore, this peer's ed25519 identity and its config. Losing it means losing the identity and everything it seeds.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Corestore, identity keypair and config. Back this up: it is this peer's identity.

Config.Name: Gateway port
Config.Description: Port for the HTTP bridge and the web UI.

Config.Name: Bind address
Config.Description: 0.0.0.0 to reach it from the LAN, 127.0.0.1 to keep it local to the server.

Config.Name: Catalog key
Config.Description: Join an existing bay by its catalog key. Leave empty to start a new bay; the key is then printed in the container log and shown on the Network screen.
